features.name: Core Street Samurai / Corporate Enforcer Class Features
1. Combat Augment Protocol (Level 1)
features.description: You calibrate your neural interface and physical sub-dermal augments for a specific combat doctrine:

features.name: Smart Link Targeting
features.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls made with ranged smart-weapons and firearms.

features.name: Sub Dermal Plating
features.description: You gain a +1 bonus to AC while wearing armor or sub-dermal weave.

features.name: Monomolecular Edge Tuning
features.description: When wielding a one-handed melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls.

features.name: Hydraulic Torque Drive
features.description: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack with a two-handed weapon, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

features.name: Hard Light Aegis Intercept
features.description: When a target within 5 feet of you is attacked, you can use your reaction to project a hard-light barrier, imposing disadvantage on the attack roll (requires a shield or cyber-shield).

features.name: Dual Rotor Actuators
features.description: When you engage in two-weapon fighting, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of the second attack.

features.name: 2. Nanite Repair Injection (Level 1)
features.description: You activate a sub-dermal auto-injector or trigger a nanite repair swarm that instantly cauterizes wounds, seals flesh, and numbs trauma.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: On your turn, you can use a bonus action to regain Hit Points equal to 1d10 + your Fighter level. (1/Short or Long Rest).

features.name: 3. Synaptic Overclock (Level 2)
features.description: You temporarily override your neural safety governors or trigger a heavy combat-stim dump, allowing your body to move at near-light reaction speeds.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: On your turn, you can take one additional action on top of your regular action and possible bonus action. (1/Short or Long Rest; 2 uses at Level 17).

features.name: 4. Combat Specialization (Level 3)
features.description: You select your operational role in Neo-Tokyo's shadow economy—whether as a street samurai, corporate field officer, or spirit-bound ward-knight.

features.name: 5. Rapid Fire Protocol (Level 5)
features.description: High-frequency weapon swings, sub-dermal recoil dampeners, and automated target cycling allow you to strike multiple targets in milliseconds.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: You can attack twice (Level 5), three times (Level 11), and four times (Level 20) whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: 6. Neural Hardening (Level 9)
features.description: You purge Black ICE neural feedback, override bioweapons, or push through physical shock through sheer grit and hardened firewall firmware. :::

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: You can reroll a saving throw that you fail, but you must use the new roll. (1/Long Rest at Level 9; 2 at Level 13; 3 at Level 17).

subclasses.name: Street Samurai
subclasses.description: Target Acquisition Optics (Level 3) Biomechanical Conditioning (Level 7) Secondary Augment Suite (Level 10) Lethal Precision Firmware (Level 15) Sub-Dermal Regen Core (Level 18)
details: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

You can add half your proficiency bonus (rounded up) to any Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution check that doesn't already use your proficiency bonus. Additionally, your running jump distance increases by a number of feet equal to your Strength modifier.
You choose a second Combat Augment Protocol from the Level 1 list.
Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18–20.
At the start of each of your turns, you regain Hit Points equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier if you have no more than half your Hit Points left and aren't at 0 HP.

features.name: Focus
features.description: Raw physical perfection, military-grade cybernetic lethality, and unmatched critical hit frequency.*

subclasses.name: Aegis Tactical Strategist
subclasses.description: Tactical Maneuver Deck (Level 3) Corporate Ordnance Certification (Level 3) :::
details: You gain proficiency with one type of artisan's tools (e.g., Arms & Cyberware Tech tools) and proficiency in System Forensics (Investigation).
Biometric Threat Scan (Level 7)
If you spend at least 1 minute observing or interacting with a target outside of combat, you can analyze their cybernetic tier, threat level, AC, HP, or physical ability scores relative to your own.
Tactical Command Reserve (Level 15)
When you roll initiative and have no Superiority Dice remaining, you immediately regain one Superiority Die.

features.name: Focus
features.description: Tactical maneuvers, squad coordination, and analyzing enemy vulnerabilities using corporate combat algorithms.*

features.name: Superiority Dice
features.description: You gain four d8 Superiority Dice to power tactical maneuvers.

features.name: Fire Discipline Command
features.description: Direct an ally to issue an immediate ranged or melee strike.

features.name: Joint Lock Disarm
features.description: Target a foe's cybernetic joints or weapon grip to force them to drop an item.

features.name: E Vector Dodge
features.description: Add a superiority die to your AC while moving through dangerous kill zones.

features.name: Counter Strike
features.description: Use your reaction when an enemy misses you to execute an immediate counter-attack.

subclasses.name: Cyber-Mage Ronin
subclasses.description: Cyber-Mage Spellcasting (Level 3) Spell-Blade Weave (Level 7) Data-Disrupting Strike (Level 10) Matrix Shift (Level 15) :::
details: You cast Wizard spells using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability, flavoring spells as active matrix code uploads (e.g., Overclock Reflexes for Shield, Blackout Arc for Thunderwave, or Hard-Light Decoy Array for Mirror Image).
Neural Weapon Sync (Level 3)

You perform a 1-hour neural synchronization with up to two weapons. Once synced, you cannot be disarmed of the weapon unless incapacitated, and you can summon it directly to your hand from anywhere on the same plane as a bonus action.
When you use your action to cast a cantrip (such as Data-Siphon or Neon Glitch), you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.
When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, that creature has disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.
When you use your Synaptic Overclock (Action Surge), you can instantly teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

features.name: Focus
features.description: Blending high-frequency blade work with awakened matrix code and offensive digital spellcasting.*

subclasses.name: Shinto Ward-Knight
subclasses.description: Spirit Ward Inscription (Level 3) Avatar Manifestation (Level 3) Shinto Barrier Reaction (Level 7) Dual Ward Protocol (Level 15)
details: You learn to carve sacred Shinto kanji and digital spirit talismans onto your gear:

As a bonus action, you channel raw ley-line energy to physically expand your form. For 1 minute, your size becomes Large, you deal an extra 1d6 damage once per turn with weapon attacks, and you have advantage on Strength checks and saving throws.
When a creature you can see within 60 feet is hit by an attack roll, you can use your reaction to force the attacker to reroll the attack roll with a sacred digital barrier.
You can invoke each of your inscribed Spirit Wards twice per short or long rest rather than once.

features.name: Focus
features.description: Channeling ancient Shinto spirit wards and ley-line energy directly into heavy armor and weapons.*

features.name: Inugami Ward Fire Rune
features.description: Infuses strikes with searing spirit fire and restrains targets with burning chains.

features.name: Raijin Ward Storm Rune
features.description: Emits a high-voltage lightning shockwave when hit in combat.

features.name: Tengu Ward Cloud Rune
features.description: Uses a reaction to invoke a wind shield, redirecting an incoming attack from yourself or an ally to another target nearby.

features.name: Spellcasting Ability
features.description: You cast spells using Wisdom. Instead of traditional holy symbols or druidic mistletoe, your spellcasting focus is a Spirit Device—a Shinto charm bound with fiber-optic wire, a spirit-attuned cyberdeck, or a talisman-engraved smartphone.

features.name: The Cyberware Tax Essence Strain
features.description: Excessive cybernetic installation disrupts your spiritual connection to the city's mana. Over-augmenting your body imposes penalties on your spell save DC or reduces spell slot recovery during short rests.

features.name: 2. Channel Divinity / Spirit Communion: Astral Intercept
features.description: You open your third eye to perceive the overlapping Astral Plane and local Matrix data streams simultaneously. Mechanics (1–3 uses/Short Rest):

features.name: Astral Sweep
features.description: You scan the area within 60 feet. For 1 minute, you see invisible targets, optical camouflage, digital ghosts, hidden wireless cameras, and astral spirits through walls and physical cover.

features.name: Turn Exorcise Code And Spirit
features.description: Force rogue AI entities, digital ghosts, or spirit-bound constructs within 30 feet to make a Wisdom saving throw or be rebuked and turned away for 1 minute.

features.name: 3. Spirit Morph
features.description: Rather than turning into woodland beasts, you project your spirit into physical form as an Awakened Urban Critter or manifest a hard-light spirit construct—such as a cyber-fox (Kitsune), a raven drone-spirit, a neon-lit alley panther, or a subterranean sewer serpent.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: Functionally identical to Druid Wild Shape, but your beast forms manifest with glowing neon circuitry, spirit-aura trails, and environmental resistance (such as resistance to Lightning or Bio-Tox/Poison damage).

features.name: 4.Ley-Line / Great Kami Override (Level 10)
features.description: You petition the ancient dragon spirits, the overarching city intelligence, or the subterranean Shinto ley lines of Neo-Tokyo for direct intervention.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: Roll a d100. If you roll equal to or lower than your Shaman level, a massive surge of spirit-lightning, citywide grid blackout, or spirit sanctuary manifests to save your party.

subclasses.name: Domain of the City Kami (Urban & Ley-Line Shaman)

features.name: Focus
features.description: Harnessing the raw energy of Neo-Tokyo's concrete, lightning, wireless power grids, and subterranean Shinto ley lines.*

features.name: Bonus Proficiency And Cantrip Level 1
features.description: You gain proficiency with Street Navigation (Survival) and learn the Data-Siphon or Neon Glitch cantrip.

features.name: Ley Line Surge Level 1
features.description: When you deal Lightning or Radiant damage with a spell, you can push a target up to 10 feet away as an urban electrical surge erupts around them.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Grid Overcharge (Level 2): As an action, you tap into local power lines or ley lines. For 1 minute, whenever an ally within 30 feet deals weapon or spell damage, they deal an additional 1d6 Lightning damage.

features.name: Concrete Sanctuary Level 6
features.description: You can step through electrical conduits, street shrines, or neon signs to instantly teleport 30 feet as a bonus action.

features.name: City Storm Level 8 14
features.description: You add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of any Shaman cantrip, and your Spirit Morph attacks deal extra Lightning or Radiant damage.

subclasses.name: Circle of the Matrix Shaman / Data-Ghost (Digital Medium)

features.name: Focus
features.description: Operating at the exact intersection where digital data bleeds into spirit magic—perceiving rogue AIs, digital ghosts, and the Ghost Signal as living astral entities.*

features.name: Ghost Code Perception Level 2
features.description: You commune directly with machines, Matrix nodes, and obsolete digital infrastructure without needing a physical cyberdeck. You gain proficiency in Cyber-Arcana (Arcana) and can cast Comprehend Languages at will to decipher encrypted code.

features.name: Data Spirit Companion Level 2
features.description: You summon a familiar made of flickering code and spirit-light (resembling a cyber-fox or digital sprite). It can deliver touch spells, scout matrix relays, and inflict Optic Glitch (Blinded) on enemies.

features.name: Matrix Shift Level 6
features.description: When targeted by an attack, you can use your reaction to temporarily dematerialize into the local data stream, gaining Optical Camouflage (Invisible) until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Ghost Signal Resonance Level 10
features.description: You emit a pulse of the global "I REMEMBER YOU" broadcast. Enemies within 30 feet must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or suffer OS Buffer Overflow (Incapacitated) for 1 round.

subclasses.name: Domain of Kitsune Bio-Magic (Spirit Essence & Healing)

features.name: Focus
features.description: Channeling spirit essence, alchemical reagents, and life-force manipulation—protecting street youth from corporate bio-extraction while providing back-alley miraculous healing.*

features.name: Disciple Of Essence Level 1
features.description: Whenever you use a spell of 1st level or higher to restore Hit Points to a creature, the target regains additional Hit Points equal to 2 + the spell's level.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Alchemical Preservation (Level 2): As an action, you project a soothing aura of spirit-essence. You restore a pool of Hit Points equal to 5 × your Shaman level, distributed among wounded allies within 30 feet.

features.name: Essence Shield Level 6
features.description: When you heal an ally, they gain a protective hard-light spirit barrier granting them temporary Hit Points equal to your Wisdom modifier + Shaman level for 1 minute.

features.name: Bio Tox Purge Level 8
features.description: Your healing spells automatically cure the target of Bio-Toxed (Poisoned), Optic Glitch (Blinded), or Acoustic Scramble (Deafened) conditions.

subclasses.name: Circle of the Neon Ronin / Ancestral Medium

features.name: Focus
features.description: Binding the spirits of fallen street samurai, pre-war warriors, and dead runners to fight corporate oppression on the streets.*

features.name: Ancestral Vengeance Level 2
features.description: When you enter combat, phantom blades and spirit armor manifest around you. When an enemy hits an ally within 30 feet, you can use your reaction to unleash an ancestral strike, dealing 1d8 Force or Psychic damage to the attacker.

features.name: Spirit Guard Level 6
features.description: Your spirit companions protect your party during high-risk operations. Allies within 10 feet of you have advantage on saving throws against Threat-Lock (Frightened) and Subliminal Override (Charmed).

features.name: Ghost Samurai Execution Level 10
features.description: Once per turn when you or an ally scores a critical hit within 30 feet of you, a phantom street samurai delivers a follow-up strike dealing 3d8 Force damage and knocking the target Grounded (Prone).

features.name: Specialized Firmware (Levels 1 & 6)
features.description: Your neural interface is flashed with custom skill software, allowing you to process specific physical or digital tasks with automated perfection.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: Choose two of your skill proficiencies (or one skill proficiency and your tools proficiency, such as Cyberdeck / Security Tools). Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of the chosen proficiencies. (Choose two more at Level 6).

features.name: Exploit Vulnerability (Level 1)
features.description: You use HUD target-lock, sensor scans, or tactical positioning to strike weak seams in sub-dermal armor, unshielded cybernetics, or neural ports.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: Once per turn, you can deal an extra 1d6 damage to one creature you hit with an attack if you have advantage on the attack roll (or if an ally is within 5 feet of the target and you don't have disadvantage). The weapon must be a finesse weapon or a ranged firearm/smart-weapon.

features.name: Progression
features.description: Increases by +1d6 every two Rogue levels (up to +10d6 at Level 19).

features.name: Street-Net Slang & Mesh-Cipher (Level 1)
features.description: A blend of encrypted mesh-net signals, fixer hand-signs, darknet slang, and symbols carved into alleyway conduits by runners in Yoru Market or The Underline.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: You can hide encrypted messages in ordinary digital broadcasts or conversation. Other street runners understand these messages automatically, while unaugmented corporate suits require an Investigation check to decipher them.

features.name: Tactical Overclock (Level 2)
features.description: Your neural reflex boosters allow you to make micro-adjustments in milliseconds.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: You can use a bonus action on each of your turns in combat to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

features.name: Reflex Mitigator (Level 5)
features.description: Sub-dermal momentum dampeners or ocular predictive algorithms roll your body with the impact of incoming kinetic strikes.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: When an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to halve the attack's damage against you.

features.name: Vector Roll (Level 7)
features.description: Micro-thrusters, sub-dermal agility augments, or instant hazard detection allow you to dive clear of explosive blasts and plasma arcs.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: When subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage (such as Blackout Arc or an EMP grenade), you take no damage if you succeed, and only half damage if you fail.

features.name: Optimized Routine (Level 11)
features.description: Your neural subroutines execute routine tasks with zero margin for human error.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: Whenever you make an ability check that lets you add your proficiency bonus, you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

features.name: Sonar Sweep / Sensor Ping (Level 14)
features.description: Cybernetic audio-dampeners, motion trackers, or electromagnetic pings register invisible physical signatures and optical camouflage.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: If you are able to hear/process sensor feeds, you aware of the location of any hidden or invisible creature within 10 feet of you.

features.name: Firewall Memory-Lock (Level 15)
features.description: Your brain is protected by hard-light mental firewalls that reject neural intruding malware and mind control.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws.

features.name: Threat-Nullification Algorithm (Level 18)
features.description: Your predictive combat HUD recalculates incoming attack trajectories instantly.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: No attack roll can have advantage against you while you aren't incapacitated.

features.name: Fail-Safe Override (Level 20)
features.description: You force a critical system bypass or luck-spike to turn a total failure into a decisive victory.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: If your attack misses a target, you can turn the miss into a hit. Alternatively, if you fail an ability check, you can treat the d20 roll as a 20. (1/Short or Long Rest).

subclasses.name: The Decker (Matrix Specialist / Hacker)
subclasses.description: Wireless Cyberdeck Sync (Level 3): ICE-Breaker Infiltration (Level 3): System Lockout (Level 9): Ghost in the Shell (Level 13): Black ICE Counter-Strike (Level 17):
details: You install a cyberdeck integrated into your nervous system. You gain proficiency with Cyberdecks (Security Tools) and System Forensics (Investigation).
You can use your Tactical Overclock (Cunning Action) to make a remote Palm-Hack (Sleight of Hand) or disable an electronic device up to 30 feet away via wireless signal.
You learn digital hack-routines (treated as spells using Intelligence as your hacking stat):
When you deal Exploit Vulnerability (Sneak Attack) damage, you can choose to deal Lightning or Psychic damage as you upload rogue code into the target's neural port.

When you hit an augmented target or construct with a Sneak Attack, you can force them to make a Constitution saving throw (DC \= 8 + your Int modifier + Proficiency Bonus). On a failure, one of their cybernetic weapons or augments is disabled, inflicting OS Buffer Overflow (Incapacitated) or Optic Glitch (Blinded) until the end of their next turn.

You can project a digital avatar into physical space using local hologram projectors or direct neural feeds. You can cast Hard-Light Decoy Array or Matrix Ghosting once per long rest without expending a spell slot.

When a target within 30 feet targets you with a spell, hack, or ranged attack, you can use your reaction to unleash a wave of Black ICE code. The attacker takes 5d10 Psychic damage and must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or be Neural Frozen (Paralyzed) until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Focus
features.description: Infiltrating digital networks, deploying Black ICE remotely, overriding enemy cyberware, and manipulating camera feeds in real time.*

features.name: Cantrips
features.description: Data-Siphon, Neon Glitch.

features.name: 1st Level Hacks
features.description: Overclock Reflexes, Blackout Arc.

subclasses.name: Corporate Operative (Infiltrator & Black-Ops Specialist)
subclasses.description: Deep Fake Credentials (Level 3): Assassination Protocol (Level 3): Misdirection & Subliminal Cue (Level 9): Impenetrable Cover (Level 13): Lethal Extraction Strike (Level 17):
details: You excel at forging corporate passes, biometric spoofing, and social infiltration. You gain proficiency with Deception (Deep Fake) and Insight (Subtext Scan).
Given 1 hour and access to a terminal, you can construct a flawless corporate identity (complete with employee ID, biometric clearance, and backdated email trails) for any of the 8 Megacorps.
You have advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn in combat yet. In addition, any hit you score against a creature that is surprised is a critical hit.

As a bonus action, you can issue a coded phrase or visual gesture that forces a target to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the target suffers Subliminal Override (Charmed) for 1 minute or until attacked, making them ignore your presence while you bypass security checkpoints.

Your mind cannot be read by neural probes, truth drugs, or spirit magic unless you allow it. Biometric scanners and facial recognition drones identify you as your current false identity unless an investigator succeeds on a System Forensics check against your passive Deception score.

When you hit a creature that is surprised with an attack, it must make a Constitution saving throw (DC \= 8 + Dex modifier + Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, double the damage of your attack against the target.

features.name: Focus
features.description: Social engineering, deep-cover identities, targeted assassinations, and manipulating corporate power dynamics.*

subclasses.name: Ghost-Runner (Street Phantom & Parkour Specialist)
subclasses.description: Vector Parkour (Level 3): Second-Story Hack (Level 3): Optical Cloak Burst (Level 9): Reflex Surge (Level 13): Ghost-Walk (Level 17):
details: You gain a climbing speed and swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

When you make a running jump, the distance you cover increases by a number of feet equal to your Dexterity modifier. You can use Dexterity instead of Strength for Hydraulic Prowess (Athletics) checks.
You can use the Palm-Hack (Sleight of Hand) skill to pick physical and electronic mag-locks in half the normal time, and climbing doesn't cost you extra movement.
When you take the Hide action on your turn, you can engage a temporary thermo-optic cloak, gaining Optical Camouflage (Invisible) until the start of your next turn or until you attack/cast a spell.
You can take two turns during the first round of any combat. You take your first turn at your normal initiative and your second turn at your initiative minus 10.

Your movement speed increases by 10 feet, and you can move through solid objects and physical barriers as if they were difficult terrain (phasing through corporate security walls or vault doors). If you end your turn inside an object, you take 1d10 Force damage and are pushed to the nearest open space.

features.name: Focus
features.description: Extreme urban mobility, bypassing physical security, climbing arcologies, and harvesting lost data from the Undercity.*

subclasses.name: Chrome Duelist (Cyber-Swashbuckler)
subclasses.description: Monomolecular Footwork (Level 3): Solo Engagement (Level 3): Chrome Flash (Level 9): Elegant Riposte (Level 13): High-Speed Execution (Level 17):
details: You add your Charisma modifier to your Initiative rolls.
During your turn, if you make a melee attack against a creature, that creature cannot make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of your turn.

You don't need advantage on your attack roll to use Exploit Vulnerability (Sneak Attack) against a creature if you are within 5 feet of it, no other creatures are within 5 feet of you, and you don't have disadvantage on the roll.

As an action, you can flash your cyber-blades or ocular optics in a blinding display. Each creature within 15 feet that can see you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or suffer Threat-Lock (Frightened) or Optic Glitch (Blinded) until the end of your next turn.
When a creature misses you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to make an immediate melee weapon attack against that creature.
Once per turn, if you miss with an attack roll, you can instantly execute a follow-up strike with advantage.

features.name: Focus
features.description: High-speed 1v1 melee combat with monomolecular katanas, flashing cyber-blades, and intimidating street presence.*

features.name: 1. Threat-Sense Sweep (Level 1)
features.description: Your ocular implants, threat-detection algorithms, and spirit-attuned sensors ping the presence of supernatural entities, rogue digital ghosts, or corporate black-ops gear.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: As an action, you expand your awareness. Until the end of your next turn, you know the location of any awakened spirit, digital ghost, rogue AI, or fiendish construct within 60 feet that is not behind total cover. You also detect any consecrated or desecrated sites (such as Shinto shrines or corrupted matrix server hubs) within range. (Uses equal to 1 + Cha modifier per Long Rest).

features.name: 2. Bio-Nanite Injector (Level 1)
features.description: You activate sub-dermal medical nanite swarms or apply high-grade corporate trauma gel to seal lethal wounds and purge bio-toxins.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: You have a pool of healing power that replenishes on a long rest, equal to 5 × your Paladin level. As an action, you can touch a creature to restore Hit Points from this pool. You can also expend 5 hit points from the pool to cure the target of Bio-Toxed (Poisoned) or neutralize a disease.

features.name: You Select A Specialized Combat Doctrine
features.description: Smart-Link Targeting (+2 ranged), Sub-Dermal Plating (+1 AC), Monomolecular Edge Tuning (+2 melee damage with one-handed weapons), or Hard-Light Aegis Intercept (Shield reaction disadvantage).

features.name: Spellcasting Ability
features.description: You cast spells using Charisma (representing your force of personality, neural authority, and code conviction). Spells are executed as encoded corporate directives, street vows, or sacred digital talismans.

features.name: 5. High-Voltage Overcharge Smite (Level 2)
features.description: When you hit with a melee weapon or cyber-blade, you channel high-voltage electrical energy or spirit-fire through the strike, cooking internal circuits and searing flesh.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend one spell slot to deal extra Lightning, Radiant, or Psychic damage to the target. The extra damage is 2d8 for a 1st-level slot, plus 1d8 for each slot level higher than 1st (to a maximum of 5d8). The damage increases by 1d8 if the target is a construct, rogue AI, or digital ghost.

features.name: 6. Sub-Dermal Bio-Filter (Level 3)
features.description: Advanced internal bio-filters and cybernetic liver augments make you immune to biological pathogens and synthetic diseases.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: You are immune to all diseases and biological viruses.

features.name: 7. Operational Vow (Level 3)
features.description: You bind yourself to an absolute mandate—whether a binding Aegis Tactical corporate contract, the ancient Bushido code of the Chrome Lotus, or the sacred protection of Neo-Tokyo's ley lines.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: You can attack twice whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: 9. Tactical Mesh Shielding (Level 6)
features.description: Your sub-dermal communication suite broadcasts protective tactical data and hard-light deflection frequencies to nearby squadmates.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: Whenever you or a friendly creature within 10 feet of you must make a saving throw, the creature gains a bonus to the saving throw equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of +1). You must be conscious to grant this bonus. (Extends to 30 feet at Level 18).

features.name: 10. Threat-Override Aura (Level 10)
features.description: Your unwavering conviction or neural combat governor overrides fear responses in yourself and your allies.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you cannot suffer from Threat-Lock (Frightened) while you are conscious. (Extends to 30 feet at Level 18).

features.name: 11. Passive High-Voltage Pulse (Level 11)
features.description: Every melee strike is permanently infused with a residual high-voltage current.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: Whenever you hit a creature with a melee weapon, the target takes an extra 1d8 Radiant or Lightning damage.

features.name: 12. System Purge (Level 14)
features.description: You issue an absolute system override to purge hostile spell effects, neural hacks, or status ailments from yourself or an ally.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: You can use your action to end one spell or magical effect on yourself or one willing creature you touch. (Uses equal to Cha modifier per Long Rest).

subclasses.name: Oath of the Aegis Enforcer
subclasses.description: Tenets of the Contract: Channel Divinity (Level 3): Anti-Override Firewall (Level 7): Smite Sentinel (Level 15): Aegis Prime Manifestation (Level 20):
details: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet cannot suffer Subliminal Override (Charmed) while you are conscious.
Whenever an enemy within 5 feet hits an ally, you can use your reaction to deliver a melee weapon attack against that enemy with an automatic Overcharge Smite.

As an action, you deploy heavy tactical exoskeleton plating and hard-light barriers for 1 minute: gain resistance to all damage, project a 30-foot aura of disadvantage against enemy attacks, and deal an extra 10 Lightning damage on all weapon strikes.

features.name: Focus
features.description: Bound by corporate contract, subscription-based law enforcement, and total tactical order.*

features.name: Duty To The Board
features.description: Execute client directives without personal hesitation.

features.name: Maintain Order
features.description: Protect corporate assets and eliminate unauthorized street chaos.

features.name: Collateral Control
features.description: Minimize non-billable destruction during pacification operations.

features.name: Neural Lock Weapon
features.description: As an action, you charge your weapon with Aegis suppression code. For 1 minute, you add your Charisma modifier to attack rolls with that weapon, and it emits bright light in a 20-foot radius.

features.name: Aegis Directive Turn The Lawless
features.description: Force rogue AIs, street gang criminals, and wild spirits within 30 feet to make a Wisdom saving throw or be turned away for 1 minute.

subclasses.name: Oath of the Chrome Samurai
subclasses.description: Tenets of the Bushido-Net: Channel Divinity (Level 3): Relentless Pursuit (Level 7): Soul of Vengeance (Level 15): Avenging Oni (Level 20):
details: When you hit a target with an opportunity attack, you can move up to half your speed as part of the same reaction without provoking opportunity attacks.

subclasses.description: Synthetic Soul Routines (Level 1): Algorithmic Equilibrium (Level 1): Hard-Light Aegis Buffer (Level 6): Core Optimization Mode (Level 14): System Restructure Protocol (Level 18):
details: When a creature you can see within 60 feet is about to roll with advantage or disadvantage, you can use your reaction to cancel the advantage or disadvantage by balancing the probability equation (uses equal to Proficiency Bonus / Long Rest).

As an action, spend 1 to 5 Surge Points to create a protective hard-light barrier around yourself or an ally within 30 feet. The barrier creates a pool of d8s equal to the points spent; when the target takes damage, roll the dice and reduce the damage by the total.
As a bonus action, spend 5 Surge Points to enter absolute system optimization for 1 minute: d20 rolls of 9 or lower count as a 10 for all your attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

features.name: Focus
features.description: An experimental synthetic human body harboring a conscious AI or synthetic soul prototype (Project ECHO from KAMI Industries).*

features.name: You Learn Bonus Hard Coded Defensive And Utility Routines
features.description: e.g., Overclock Reflexes, Blackout Arc, Hard-Light Decoy Array, Hard-Light Aegis Dome.

features.name: 1. Contracting Entity (Otherworldly Patron - Level 1)
features.description: You sign a binding operational agreement with a mega-scale entity in Neo-Tokyo's hierarchy. In exchange for your field services, your patron routes encrypted power, black-budget funds, and neural subroutines directly into your optic feed.

features.name: Spellcasting Ability
features.description: You cast spells using Charisma (representing your contract negotiation leverage, force of personality, and neural clearance).

features.name: Bandwidth Refresh Short Rest Recovery
features.description: Unlike standard mages who memorize long algorithms, your spell slots represent allocated corporate bandwidth. Your spell slots are always cast at the highest available level and recharge completely whenever you finish a Short Rest (as your system executes a rapid corporate bandwidth refresh).

features.name: 3. Black-Market Firmware Patches (Eldritch Invocations - Level 2)
features.description: You install custom cybernetic and neural firmware modifications provided by your corporate contract:

features.name: Overclocked Beam Agonizing Blast
features.description: Add your Charisma modifier to the damage roll of your Ghost-Byte or Eldritch Blast* cantrip.

features.name: Thermal Optic Vision Devil S Sight
features.description: You can see normally in non-magical and magical darkness (or optical smoke/glitch zones) up to 120 feet.

features.name: Sub Dermal Kinetic Weave Armor Of Shadows
features.description: You can cast Mage Armor* on yourself at will without expending a spell slot or material components.

features.name: Neural Translator Eyes Of The Rune Keeper
features.description: You can read all writing, encrypted digital codes, and matrix data streams automatically.

features.name: Voice Spoofing Modulator Beast Speech Mask Of Many Faces
features.description: You can cast Disguise Self* at will to spoof facial-recognition drones and corporate ID scans.

features.name: 4. Corporate Retainer Asset (Pact Boon - Level 3)
features.description: Your employer grants you a specialized operational asset:

features.name: Asset
features.description: Biometric Priority Pass (Pact of the Talisman): You wear a corporate priority pass or dragon-engraved talisman. When the wearer fails an ability check or saving throw, they can add a 1d4* to the roll.

features.name: 5. Executive Mystic Arcanum (Level 11)
features.description: Your patron unlocks classified, high-level corporate clearance code (granting one 6th, 7th, 8th, and 9th-level spell slot) that executes once per Long Rest without consuming standard bandwidth.

features.name: 6. Unlimited Bandwidth Override (Eldritch Master - Level 20)
features.description: You issue an emergency contract override, demanding an immediate full-bandwidth replenishment from your patron's deep server core.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: You can spend 1 minute petitioning your patron to instantly regain all your expended Pact Magic spell slots (1/Long Rest).

subclasses.name: The Dragon Boardroom
subclasses.description: Dragon Hoard Dividend (Level 1): Market Leverage (Level 6): Scales of Wealth & Resistance (Level 10): Dragon-Fire Market Crash (Level 14):
details: When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 Hit Points, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to your Charisma modifier + your Warlock level as raw spirit-energy and wealth dividend recharges your aura.
When you make an ability check or saving throw, you can call upon your dragon patron's probability algorithms to add a 1d10 to the roll (1/Short or Long Rest).
At the end of a short or long rest, choose one damage type (e.g., Fire, Lightning, Psychic). You gain resistance to that damage type until you choose a different one.

When you hit a creature with an attack, you can instantly transport the target through a hallucinatory digital dragon hoard in the deep Matrix. The target vanishes and takes 10d10 Psychic / Fire damage as its mind burns under dragon-fire. It reappears at the end of your next turn (1/Long Rest).

features.name: Focus
features.description: Contracted to dragon-backed financial institutions like Ryujin Trust; channels ancient dragon-fire, market leverage, and ruthless wealth reserves.*

features.name: Expanded Contract Spells
features.description: Command, Burning Hands, Scorching Ray, Fireball, Wall of Fire, Flame Strike.

subclasses.name: Ghost Signal
subclasses.description: Neural Mesh Telepathy (Level 1): Subconscious Glitch Shield (Level 6): Firewall Thought Shield (Level 10): Digital Thrall Override (Level 14):
details: You can telepathically communicate with any creature you can see within 30 feet without needing a physical cyberdeck or comms link. The target understands you as long as it speaks at least one language.

When a creature makes an attack roll against you, you can use your reaction to project a local optic glitch, imposing disadvantage on the roll. If the attack misses, your next attack against that creature before the end of your next turn has advantage (1/Short or Long Rest).

Your thoughts cannot be read by neural probes or magic unless you allow it. You gain resistance to Psychic damage, and whenever a creature deals Psychic damage to you, that creature takes the same amount of damage back.

You use a touch to upload a permanent neural override into an Incapacitated human or construct. The target suffers Subliminal Override (Charmed) by you indefinitely, obeying your mental commands until cured by Remove Curse or a firewall scrub.

features.name: Focus
features.description: Bound to autonomous deep-net AIs, Project ECHO, or the broadcast source of the 2089 Ghost Signal ("I REMEMBER YOU").*

features.name: Expanded Contract Spells
features.description: Dissonant Whispers, Neural Feedback Loop, Detect Thoughts, Neural Hijack, Global Ghost Signal Broadcast.

subclasses.name: The Corporate Arch-Executive
subclasses.description: Broadcast Glamour (Level 1): Optical Escape (Level 6): Subliminal Immunity (Level 10): Mass Recommendation Loop (Level 14):
details: As an action, you emit a wave of subliminal media glamour. Each creature in a 10-foot cube centered on you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or suffer Subliminal Override (Charmed) or Threat-Lock (Frightened) until the end of your next turn (1/Short or Long Rest).

When you take damage, you can use your reaction to turn Optically Camouflaged (Invisible) and instantly teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You remain invisible until the start of your next turn (1/Short or Long Rest).
You are immune to being Subliminally Overridden (Charmed). When another creature attempts to charm or neural-control you, you can use your reaction to reflect the attempt back at the caster.

As an action, target a creature within 60 feet. It must succeed on a Wisdom save or be plunged into an immersive holographic VR loop for 1 minute. While trapped, the target is Optic Glitched (Blinded) and Acoustic Scrambled (Deafened), suffering Subliminal Override (Charmed) or Threat-Lock (Frightened) (1/Long Rest).

features.name: Focus
features.description: Contracted to media conglomerates (Amaterasu Media), high-society glitz lords of The Garden, or syndicate bosses like Madame Yumi; uses subliminal charm, optical cloaks, and media dominance.*

features.name: Expanded Contract Spells
features.description: Faerie Fire, Sleep, Phantasmal Force, Hard-Light Decoy Array, Synthetic Memory Rewrite.

subclasses.name: Subterranean Ley-Line Entity
subclasses.description: Ley-Line Plasma Conduit (Level 1): Sub-Dermal Aquifer / Electrical Shield (Level 6): Electrolyte Defense (Level 10): Ley-Line Grid Gate (Level 14):
details: As a bonus action, you summon a 10-foot spectral conduit or high-voltage plasma tentacle at a point you can see within 60 feet. You can make a melee spell attack against a target within 10 feet of it, dealing 1d8 Lightning or Cold damage on a hit and reducing their speed by 10 feet.

You gain a swimming speed of 30 feet and can breathe underwater (navigating flooded Mizu Ward). Additionally, when taking Cold or Lightning damage, you can use your reaction to gain resistance to that instance of damage and deal 1d8 Lightning damage back to the attacker.

You project a protective aura of electrified mist or spirit-data. You and allies within 10 feet gain resistance to Fire damage, and you can cast Evard's Black Tentacles (flavored as high-voltage copper cable bundles) once per long rest without spending a spell slot.

As an action, you submerge yourself into a local power conduit or flooded drainage grate, instantly teleporting up to 1 mile to another power node or body of water you have seen. A massive lightning surge blasts outward at the destination, dealing 6d10 Lightning damage to surrounding enemies.

features.name: Focus
features.description: Contracted to the ancient digital-magical entity sleeping beneath the Dead City and tapped by Izanagi Grid; manipulates high-voltage conduits, water-slicked cabling, and ley-line plasma.*

features.name: Expanded Contract Spells
features.description: Thunderwave, Create or Destroy Water, Blackout Arc, Lightning Bolt, Izanagi Grid Overload.

features.name: Spellcasting Ability
features.description: You cast spells using Charisma (representing your viral presence, audience engagement, and neural broadcast authority).

features.name: Media Focus
features.description: A holographic micro-deck, a neural neck-mic, a spirit-attuned synthesizer, a laser-display instrument, or a high-end Amaterasu streaming rig.

features.name: 2. Viral Hype / Subliminal Boost (Level 1)
features.description: You broadcast a tailored hype-track, motivational neural ping, or tactical combat audio cue that overclocks an ally's confidence and reaction time.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: As a bonus action, target one creature within 60 feet that can hear or receive your signal. That creature gains a Hype Die (d6, scaling to d8, d10, d12). Within the next 10 minutes, the target can add the die to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes.

features.name: 3. Social Algorithm Analytics (Level 2)
features.description: Your neural interface continuously scrapes trend data, social archives, and street mesh networks, granting you basic competence across all topics.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: You can add half your proficiency bonus (rounded down) to any ability check you make that doesn't already include your proficiency bonus.

features.name: 4. Defrag Stream / Chill-Vibe Lounge (Level 2)
features.description: During a short rest, you broadcast soothing synthwave ambient tracks or low-frequency lo-fi beats that accelerate cellular repair and calm fried neural pathways.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: If you or any friendly creatures regain Hit Points at the end of a short rest by spending Hit Dice, each creature regains an extra 1d6 Hit Points (scaling to 1d8, 1d10, 1d12).

features.name: 5. Viral Brand Mastery (Levels 3 & 10)
features.description: You master specific public manipulation tools—such as Idol Presence (Performance), Deep Fake (Deception), or Fixer Negotiation (Persuasion).

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: Choose two of your skill proficiencies. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of the chosen proficiencies. (Choose two more at Level 10).

features.name: 6. Rapid Hype Refresh (Level 5)
features.description: Your viral feed refreshes constantly; short breaks allow you to regain full stream engagement.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: You regain all of your expended uses of Viral Hype (Bardic Inspiration) when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

features.name: 7. Signal-Jacker / Static Scrub (Level 6)
features.description: You emit a localized white-noise jammer or anti-propaganda frequency that shields nearby minds from mind control and dread.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: As an action, you begin a broadcast that lasts until the end of your next turn. You and friendly creatures within 30 feet have advantage on saving throws against suffering Threat-Lock (Frightened) or Subliminal Override (Charmed).

features.name: 8. Cross-Net Code Piracy (Levels 10, 14, 18)
features.description: You hack into rival corporate networks (like KAMI or Kitsune Bio-Magic) to rip off proprietary spell code and compile it into your media rig.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: Choose two spells from any class list (including spells like Global Ghost Signal Broadcast or Hard-Light Aegis Dome). These spells count as Bard spells for you and are included in your known spell list.

features.name: 9. Emergency Hype Seed (Level 20)
features.description: Even when your stream drops offline, your neural core automatically generates an emergency viral surge when combat erupts.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: When you roll initiative and have no uses of Viral Hype remaining, you immediately regain one use.

subclasses.name: College of the Cyber Idol
subclasses.description: Hologram Glamour (Level 3): Subliminal Enthrallment (Level 3): Idol Presence (Level 6): Unstoppable Viral Hype (Level 14):
details: As a bonus action, spend 1 use of Viral Hype to project a hard-light avatar sequence. Choose a number of allies within 60 feet up to your Charisma modifier. Each ally gains temporary Hit Points equal to your Hype Die result and can immediately use their reaction to move up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

If you perform or stream for at least 1 minute, you can force humanoids watching you to make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failure, targets suffer Subliminal Override (Charmed) for 1 hour, idolizing you and ignoring non-violent environment distractions.

As a bonus action, project an aura of absolute celebrity for 1 minute. As long as the aura is active, whenever a creature attempts to attack you on its turn, it must make a Wisdom save. On a failure, it loses its attack against you and must choose a new target.

As an action, enter a dazzling hard-light transformation for 1 minute. You project bright neon light in a 30-foot radius, and whenever a creature hits you for the first time on a turn, it must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or suffer Optic Glitch (Blinded) until the end of its next turn.

features.name: Focus
features.description: Pop stars, holographic idols in Neon Shinjuku, and sponsored icons of Amaterasu Media; uses dazzling hard-light aesthetics and overwhelming audience devotion.*

subclasses.name: College of the Pirate Broadcaster
subclasses.description: Cutting Counter-Troll (Level 3): Pirate Mesh Intelligence (Level 3): Leaked Code Clearance (Level 6): Peerless Analytics (Level 14):
subclasses.focus: Inspired by independent street journalists like Daisuke "Radio" and hacktivists in The 404s; uncovers corporate cover-ups, broadcasts raw street truth, and trolls enemy comms.*
details: When a creature you can see within 60 feet makes an attack roll, ability check, or damage roll, you can use your reaction and spend 1 use of Viral Hype to roll the die and subtract the number from the creature's roll.
You gain proficiency in 3 additional skills of your choice (e.g., System Forensics [Investigation], Cyber-Arcana [Arcana], or Deep Fake [Deception]).
You learn two additional Cross-Net Code Piracy spells from any class list at 6th level instead of waiting for 10th level.
When you make an ability check, you can expend 1 use of Viral Hype to roll the Hype Die and add the number to your check.

subclasses.name: College of Chrome & Blades
subclasses.description: Combat Streamer Training (Level 3): Blade-Flourish Stream Subroutines (Level 3): Extra Attack (Level 6): Master Flourish (Level 14):
subclasses.focus: Gladiatorial battle-streamers, street samurai influencers, and duelists who perform high-lethality combat for live subscriber feeds.*
subclasses.defensive_flourish: Add the Hype Die to the damage dealt and to your AC until the start of your next turn.
subclasses.slashing_flourish: Add the Hype Die to the damage dealt, and deal that same amount of damage to another creature within 5 feet.
subclasses.mobile_flourish: Add the Hype Die to damage and push the target up to 5 + Hype Die feet away, using your reaction to move adjacent to them.
details: You gain proficiency with medium armor, shields, and martial weapons (such as monomolecular katanas and smart-pistols).
Whenever you take the Attack action, your walking speed increases by 10 feet until the end of the turn. When you hit with a melee attack, you can expend 1 use of Viral Hype to execute a flourish:
You can attack twice whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
Whenever you execute a Blade Flourish subroutine, you can roll a d6 instead of expending a Viral Hype die.

subclasses.name: College of Subliminal Propaganda
subclasses.description: Neural Venom Strike (Level 3): Subliminal Dread (Level 3): Steal Memory Persona (Level 6): Shadow Whispers (Level 14):
subclasses.focus: Amaterasu Media psychological operatives and host-club manipulators like Madame Yumi's Velvet Dolls; extracts executive secrets, implants false memories, and weaponizes fear.*
details: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can spend 1 use of Viral Hype to inject a wave of psychological terror code, dealing an extra 2d6 Psychic damage (scaling to 3d6, 5d6, 8d6).

If you speak to a humanoid alone for at least 1 minute, you can plant a hidden neural seed. The target must succeed on a Wisdom save or suffer Threat-Lock (Frightened) of you or a designated creature for 1 hour.

When a humanoid dies within 30 feet of you, you can use your reaction to capture its memory profile into a blank chip. As an action, you can wear the persona for 1 hour—gaining its voice, accent, surface memories, and Deep Fake (Deception) advantage to impersonate them flawlessly.

As an action, whisper a corrupted neural phrase to a creature within 30 feet. It must succeed on a Wisdom save or become paranoia-ridden, suffering Subliminal Override (Charmed) by you while viewing all its allies as lethal enemies for 8 hours.

features.name: 1. Specialized Contract Target (Level 1)
features.description: You install specialized biometric databases, combat algorithms, and threat-analysis firmware tailored to track and execute specific quarry.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: Choose a target category: Corporate Strike Teams / Mercenaries, Cybernetically Augmented Humans, Awakened Spirits / Street Shamans, Rogue AIs / Constructs, or Mutated Urban Critters. You have advantage on Street Navigation (Survival) checks to track your target and System Forensics (Investigation) checks to recall data about them. (Choose additional target types at Levels 6 & 14).

features.name: 2. District Attunement (Level 1)
features.description: You master navigating specific vertical layers and hazardous environments across Neo-Tokyo.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: Choose a district environment type: The Crown (Sky Arcologies), The Neon Layer (Commercial/Nightlife), The Undercity (Flooded Ruins & Tunnels), or The Dead City (Quarantine & Glitch Zones).

details: Difficult terrain in your chosen environment doesn't slow your group's travel.
Your group can't become lost except by magical or high-tier matrix distortion.
When tracking targets, you learn their exact numbers, size, and how long ago they passed through the zone.

features.name: 3. Combat Augment Protocol (Level 2)
features.description: Select a specialized combat doctrine:

features.name: Smart Link Targeting Archery
features.description: +2 bonus to attack rolls with ranged smart-weapons and firearms.

features.name: Sub Dermal Plating Defense
features.description: +1 bonus to AC while wearing armor or sub-dermal weave.

features.name: Dual Rotor Actuators Two Weapon Fighting
features.description: Add your ability modifier to the damage of off-hand attacks.

features.name: Monomolecular Edge Tuning Dueling
features.description: +2 bonus to damage rolls with one-handed melee weapons.

features.name: Spellcasting Ability
features.description: You cast spells using Wisdom (representing tactical awareness, sensor interpretation, and zone instinct).

features.name: Tactical Scanner Field Kit
features.description: A wrist-mounted sensor array, laser-designator visor, or spirit-attuned tracking charm.

features.name: 5. Threat Sensor Sweep (Level 3)
features.description: You ping local wireless frequencies, sonar grids, and astral currents to detect nearby targets.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: Spend one spell slot to execute an environmental sensor sweep. For 1 minute per level of the slot used, you sense whether any specialized contract targets (constructs, spirits, augmented humans, or rogue AIs) are within 1 mile of you (or up to 6 miles within your attuned district).

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: You can attack twice whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: 7. Environmental Bypass (Level 8)
features.description: Micro-thrusters, sub-dermal leg actuators, and hazard-shielding allow you to move unimpeded through urban hazards.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: Moving through non-magical difficult terrain (flooded streets, fallen rubble, barbed wire) costs no extra movement. You also have advantage on saving throws against environmental bio-hazards, acid fog, and toxic spills.

features.name: 8. Optical Camouflage Scrub (Level 10)
features.description: Given 1 minute, you apply thermo-optic camouflage spray, street-chaff, and signal-dampening mesh to blend seamlessly into walls and alleyways.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: You gain a +10 bonus to Low-Signature (Stealth) checks as long as you remain motionless against a solid surface.

features.name: 9. Phantom Step (Level 14)
features.description: You purge your physical radar cross-section and digital trace on the fly.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: You can use the Hide action as a bonus action on your turn. You can't be tracked by non-magical means or corporate camera algorithms unless you choose to leave a digital trail.

features.name: 10. Motion Tracker / Sensor Mesh (Level 18)
features.description: Cybernetic audio-dampeners, motion trackers, and thermal optics render physical cover and darkness irrelevant.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: You do not suffer disadvantage on attack rolls against targets you can't see, and you are aware of the location of any invisible creature within 30 feet unless it is successfully hiding from you.

features.name: 11. Target Execution Protocol (Level 20)
features.description: Your HUD calculates lethal weak points in real time.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: Once on each of your turns, you can add your Wisdom modifier to the attack roll or damage roll of an attack made against one of your specialized contract targets.

features.name: Focus
features.description: Precision bounty hunting, neutralizing high-value targets, and surviving brutal street skirmishes.*

features.name: Hunter S Tech Level 3
features.description: Choose one tactical subroutine:

features.name: Colossus Takedown
features.description: Deal an extra 1d8 damage once per turn when hitting a target below its HP maximum.

features.name: Crowd Control Spray
features.description: When you make a ranged attack, you can make a secondary attack against a target within 5 feet of the primary target.

features.name: Counter Strike Parry
features.description: When a creature misses you with a melee attack, use your reaction to make an immediate counter-attack.

features.name: Defensive Augments Level 7
features.description: Choose one defensive upgrade:

features.name: Sub Dermal Blast Plating
features.description: Gain resistance to area-effect damage (like grenades or plasma blasts).

features.name: Target Lock Evasion
features.description: Opportunistic attacks against you are made with disadvantage.

features.name: Multi Target Lock Level 11
features.description: Use your action to execute a rapid salvo, making a ranged or melee attack against any number of targets within 10 feet of a point you can see.

features.name: Reflex Counter Level 15
features.description: When a target hits or misses you with an attack, use your reaction to deliver an immediate counter-strike.

subclasses.name: Bio-Drone Handler
subclasses.description: Bio-Drone Companion (Level 3): Coordination Strike (Level 7): Bio-Force Overclock (Level 11): Shared Augments (Level 15):
details: You gain a loyal Bio-Drone Companion—such as a cyber-enhanced Doberman (Hoshi Biodyne hound), an autonomous military quad-copter drone, or an awakened spirit-critter from Kitsune-cho.

The companion uses a specialized stat block (Bio-Drone of the Land, Air, or Water). It obeys your mental commands, takes its turn on your initiative, and adds your Proficiency Bonus to its AC, attack rolls, and damage rolls.
When you take the Attack action, you can command your companion to use its reaction to make one melee or ranged attack.
When your companion takes the Attack action, it can make two attacks or use a high-voltage EMP discharge.
When you cast a spell targeting yourself (such as Optical Camouflage or Overclock Reflexes), the spell also affects your Bio-Drone companion if it is within 30 feet.

features.name: Focus
features.description: Operating genetically engineered guard beasts, cyber-enhanced hounds, or military surveillance drones.*

subclasses.name: Ghost-Zone Infiltrator
subclasses.description: Ghost-Zone Specialist (Level 3): Optic Scrub (Level 3): Iron Mind Firewall (Level 7): Stalking Counter (Level 11): Shadow Dodge (Level 15):
details: You learn the Disguise Self spell and gain Thermal-Optics (Darkvision) up to 60 feet (or extend existing darkvision by 30 feet).
You are invisible to creatures and camera drones that rely on darkvision/thermal optics to see in total darkness.
You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws (protecting your mind from neural probes and Black ICE).
Once on each of your turns when you miss with a weapon attack, you can make another weapon attack as part of the same action.
Whenever a creature makes an attack roll against you without advantage, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the roll.

features.name: Focus
features.description: Operating in total darkness, underground subway tunnels in The Underline, and the erased ruins of Shiba Void; striking from the shadows before targets realize you're there.*

features.name: Dread Strike
features.description: You add your Wisdom modifier to Initiative rolls. On your first turn in combat, your speed increases by 10 feet, and your first successful attack deals an extra 1d8 weapon damage.

subclasses.name: Cyber-Zone Guardian
subclasses.description: Data-Glitch Sensor (Level 3): Phase-Strike Converter (Level 3): Matrix Phase Step (Level 7): Spatial Teleport Strike (Level 11): Data Shift Defense (Level 15):
details: You can detect matrix phase-shifts, spirit portals, and spatial glitches within 1 mile as an action.

As a bonus action, target a creature within 30 feet. For the rest of the turn, all damage you deal converts to pure Force / Psychic damage, and your first strike deals an extra 1d6 Force damage (scaling to 2d6 at Level 11).
When you take the Dodge action, you temporarily phase into the local data grid, gaining resistance to all damage until the start of your next turn.
When you take the Attack action, you can teleport up to 10 feet before each attack. If you attack at least two different targets, you can make a third attack for free.
When you take damage, you can use your reaction to phase out of reality, gaining resistance to all damage from that instance.

features.name: Focus
features.description: Hunting targets across phase-shifted matrix anomalies, subterranean energy nodes, and spatial data-glitches in Shiba Void.*
